summary: Frequency Electronics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 1,739,131 common shares at $57.50 per share, raising $100.0M. The company offered 1,086,957 shares, while selling stockholders Edenbrook Value Fund and Edenbrook Long Only Value Fund (affiliates of board member Jonathan Brolin) offered 652,174 shares. Proceeds to the company before expenses were $58.75M; selling stockholders received $35.25M. Morgan Stanley and Craig-Hallum acted as underwriters, with a 30-day option for 260,869 additional shares. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: share overhang from selling stockholders and post-offering price dynamics.
